Allows to view current config

Usage:
  cscli config [command] [flags]
  cscli config [command]

Available Commands:
  feature-flags             Displays feature flag status
  show                      Displays current config
  show-yaml                 Displays merged config.yaml + config.yaml.local

Flags:
  -h, --help   help for config

Global Flags:
      --color string    Output color: yes, no, auto (default "auto")
  -c, --config string   path to crowdsec config file (default "/etc/crowdsec/config.yaml")
      --debug           Set logging to debug
      --error           Set logging to error
      --info            Set logging to info
  -o, --output string   Output format: human, json, raw
      --trace           Set logging to trace
      --warning         Set logging to warning

Use "cscli config [command] --help" for more information about a command.

Error: cscli config: unknown command "check" for "cscli config"
